GradGuard Tuition Insurance
Protect your college investment today through GradGuard Tuition Insurance! GradGuard’s Tuition Insurance can help students and parents avoid a financial loss due to an unexpected medical withdrawal from school. Tuition Insurance broadens EMU’s existing refund policy. Tuition Insurance can reimburse tuition, room, board, and other eligible fees if a student withdraws at any time during the covered term.

Attention MET Families
MET will apply to your account as charges are assessed. Adjustments may be needed if additional aid is awarded. If you are in the MET program, have your schedule set for the upcoming term, and need a review of credits please send an email to eBill.
1098T Information
SBS sends an email with the subject: "Important Tax Information needed," "Second Notice," and "FINAL Notice" from eBill requesting required tax information be provided by filling out the W9s form. If you elect not to submit the required information for the IRS you may be charged to process it in the future. All late filings are subject to a $50 fine.

Important Information for Winter 2027
During the June 2022 meeting, the EMU Board of Regents approved the adoption of a Block Tuition pricing model. Undergraduate students taking between 12 and 16 credit hours will pay one flat tuition rate. Additional information can be found under Tuition and Fees and explained here.
The Winter 2027 Pay In Full Date is January 7, 2027.
Winter charges will be applied to the student accounts November 10, 2026.
The Fee Free Six Payment Plan will be open for enrollment November 10th, 2026. A down payment of 1/6 is due at sign up, this is the first installment of the payment plan. Once enrolled in the payment plan, the bill will be broken down into five additional installments and due dates will be as follows: December 17, January 7, January 28, February 18 and March 11.
A Fee Free Five payment plan will be open for enrollment November 11, 2026 as well. The 4 and 3 Installment plan will be open later in the semester. Pick the payment plan that works best for your financial needs.
EMU has partnered with GradGuard Tuition Insurance to provide students the option of protecting their college investment. Learn more
